title: Vacuum breaker installation.
officialText:
Vacuum breakers shall be installed a minimum of 6 inches (152 mm) above the flood level rim
of the fixture or device in accordance with Section PC 608. The flood level rim of hose connections shall be the maximum height at
which any hose is utilized.
